purpose: Runtime approximation of the neutral, non-camera world lighting. The approved orange panorama stays visible but supplies no environment illumination.
colorConvention: Linear RGB arrays for Three.Color.fromArray; proposed by visual review, not sampled from an HDRI or native registry.

hemisphere.qualification: Explicit S5 approximation of neutral daylight and broad passage fill, not an exported/baked Blender sky.

sourceLights.note: Previous ART lights remain in source but hide_render=true. Do not export those disabled lights. World Multiple Scattering strength0.11 is not a runtime environment intensity.

materials.emission: All new Principled shaders have default black emission, unlinked from Base Color. Bake Base Color without inventing emission.
materials.surface: Principled; graphite metallic0.10, other roles0.025; roughness floor0.66, graphite0.55, wall/cafe0.58, yellow/cyan0.46. Authored alpha connected for source render states2/4/32.
materials.note: These are artist materials, not a native render-state shader reconstruction.

limits: An indoor-armory concept cannot replace the authenticated exterior geometry.
Orange panorama remains as approved; its mismatch with the concept daylight is documented.
Verify runtime screenshots before claiming visual match; numerical proposal is not a pixel parity measurement.
